messages.content: Photosynthesis is how plants make their own food using sunlight. They take in carbon dioxide and water, then use light energy to turn them into sugar (glucose) and oxygen. The basic equation is: 6CO₂ + 6H₂O + light → C₆H₁₂O₆ + 6O₂. This process happens mainly in the leaves, where special pigments like chlorophyll capture sunlight.
